name: Big Sam
source:
A member of the Andou yakuza group and one of Jay's minions. Sam is a former fighter and the owner of a giant body. He sometimes runs out of control because he can't control his emotions. Sam is [url=/c98966]Niinuma[/url]'s partner who loves him deeply and will easily risk his own life for his beloved. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E4%BD%BF%E3%83%8E%E4%BA%8C%E6%8C%BA%E6%8B%B3%E9%8A%83]Wikipedia[/url].]
